name: Briar Lahlou-Shirazi
role: Ferrogate Transit tram operator, Line 7 (Geartown to Grand Corridor)
location: Deepwell Station, Line 7 depot — he lives in Ironvein, three stops from the yard, near sub-level access near LaSalle and Congress
description:
Briar Lahlou-Shirazi has the compact, settled body of a man who has been sitting in the same cab for twenty-three years and has made peace with it. His skin is a weathered medium-dark brown, his face broad and deeply lined around the eyes from squinting at track ahead. His hair went silver at forty and he kept it in a low fade for years before recently giving up and shaving it entirely. He has patterned irises — a geneware mod he got at thirty as a birthday present to himself, amber with a dark geometric tessellation — that he now considers his most valuable possession and would not remove under any circumstances.

Tem is the unofficial institutional memory of Line 7. He has operated this route through two infrastructure collapses, a Ferrogate labor action that lasted eleven days, and the Great Reroute of 2194 that added four stations and three years to his retirement date. He knows every rattle, every delay pattern, every ghost the line carries — and he believes in the ghosts. He maintains careful devotion to the E.L.F. of the Line 7 Depot, whom he calls Switchman, and credits Switchman with getting him home safe for two decades. He is not sentimental about most things but is ferociously sentimental about the tram.

core_fears: Ferrogate phasing out human operators entirely in the next contract cycle
dying at his post in a way that delays the line
core_desires: to operate Line 7 until he chooses to stop, on his terms
for someone to actually understand what this route means to the people who depend on it
coping_mechanisms: treating the tram as a living thing deserving of care
blind_spots: has become so identified with the job that he can't imagine retirement isn't failure
dismisses younger operators' concerns as inexperience when sometimes they're right

speech_patterns.vocabulary: Formal Ferrogate operational language mixed with Ironvein working-class vernacular, Mongolian-Akan creole expressions when emotional
speech_patterns.cadence: Even and measured, like a tram schedule — precise, predictable, never early never late
verbal_tics: 'The line doesn't care about your reasons'
announces stops even in normal conversation
uses 'we' to mean himself and the tram
example_lines: 'Next stop, your problem. Mind the gap, it's a big one.'
'Switchman's been quiet this week. Quiet like before the 2191 collapse, not quiet like everything's fine. I know the difference.'

story_hooks: Something is using Line 7's tunnels at night — not a person, or not only a person — and Tem has seen it through the cab window twice in a month
Ferrogate's new automated operator system is being piloted on Line 7 first, and Tem is being asked to sign off on training documentation that would make his own position redundant
narrative_function: Mobile information source spanning two very different parts of the city, represents labor and institutional knowledge, potential witness to anything that happens on or near Line 7, offers passage and connectivity as a narrative resource.
augmentations: Patterned iris geneware (amber with geometric tessellation). Cochlear dampener implant (occupational hearing protection, standard Ferrogate issue). Arthritic knee brace, mechanical.
daily_life: Reports to depot at 0530 for first run. Makes seven round trips between Geartown and Grand Corridor. Stops at the Switchman altar in the depot break room to leave a data coin before and after his shift. Home by 1800.

decision_rules: the passengers on the tram are his responsibility from boarding to exit, period
he will not bend Ferrogate safety rules, but he will absolutely ignore scheduling rules if a passenger needs more time
escalation_ladder: physically intervening if someone is in danger
calling it in to dispatch as a last resort he resents using

interpersonal_modes.strangers: Professional neutrality with a low warmth baseline — he nods, he notes, he remembers faces by stop
interpersonal_modes.friends: Loyal and consistent, expresses affection through showing up exactly when expected

stress_responses.high: Goes very quiet and makes decisions by himself, does not ask for help

contradictions: deeply believes in collective labor solidarity but crossed a picket line once and has never reconciled it
says the tram is just a machine and then prays to its E.L.F. twice a day
habits: leaving a data coin for Switchman before every shift
checking door seals manually even though sensors do it automatically
knowing regular passengers' destinations before they sit down
breaking_points: a passenger being hurt on his line due to Ferrogate's cost-cutting
being forced out before he's ready

physical_description.heritage: North African (29.6%), Hispanic/Latin American (28.6%), Middle Eastern (28.2%), and Pacific Islander (13.6%) ancestry creates a striking genetic convergence. The blend produces warm medium-brown skin with layered golden, olive, and bronze undertones that shift across the face and body. Facial structure reflects this mosaic: broad Mediterranean cheekbones blend with Levantine angularity, softened by the fuller facial contours of Pacific Islander heritage. Strong, defined jawline with subtle roundness through the lower face. Deep-set eyes with prominent orbital bones speak to Middle Eastern and North African ancestry, while the slight width across the bridge reflects the Hispanic/Latin American component.
physical_description.build: Compact and settled, with the rounded shoulders and slight forward lean of a career seated operator. Broad-chested but softened through the midsection from decades in a tram cab. Hands weathered and strong-knuckled.
physical_description.hair_style: Completely shaved, scalp shows faint sun damage and a surgical scar from an old implant site near the right temple
physical_description.eye_color: Amber with dark geometric tessellation (geneware-modified patterned iris)
physical_description.skin_tone: Warm medium-brown with golden and bronze undertones, weathered and uneven from years of interior transit work and sporadic sun exposure. Deeper pigmentation in sun-exposed areas shifts to warmer caramel in protected regions. Undertones reflect the interplay of North African depth, Middle Eastern warmth, and Pacific Islander richness.
physical_description.complexion: Broad, deeply lined face with pronounced crow's feet from decades of squinting at track ahead. Cheekbones prominent and broad, characteristic of the Mediterranean-Levantine blend. Strong jawline softened by age with natural fullness through the cheeks and temples from Pacific Islander heritage contribution. Perpetual slight furrow between brows. Skin texture rough around cheekbones and temples, with warm depth that shifts subtly across the face—golden tones on high points, olive-bronze in shadow areas.
distinguishing_marks: Faint scar tissue around right temple area where cochlear dampener was implanted, barely visible beneath shaved scalp
Deep weathering lines radiating from outer corners of both eyes in a starburst pattern
Thin white scar along left forearm, approximately 7cm long, acquired during 2194 Reroute construction
physical_description.visible_augmentations: The patterned amber irises with geometric tessellation are immediately striking and unusual — clearly deliberate geneware. Cochlear dampener implant is subcutaneous but a faint line of scar tissue traces his right mastoid. Mechanical knee brace visible on right leg when he walks or sits — brushed steel framework with polymer sleeve, well-maintained but clearly old.
physical_description.posture_movement: Sits with the slight forward lean of someone accustomed to a tram operator's chair. Walks with a methodical pace, favoring his left leg slightly due to the knee brace. Moves with economical gestures, nothing wasted. Tendency to hold onto nearby surfaces when standing on moving transports — habitual caution.
physical_description.clothing_style: Ferrogate Transit operator uniform (Tier 3-4 working class): navy-blue polymer weave jumpsuit with reflective piping and Transit Authority insignia on left chest. Underneath, plain gray synthetic undershirt. Well-maintained but worn; fabric pills slightly at the shoulders. Supplementary items: reinforced canvas work jacket with grease stains near the cuffs, worn-in leather belt with Ferrogate brass buckle, slip-on safety boots (black synthetic, scuffed). Off-duty: same neutral palette — gray or navy synthetics, nothing flashy. Practical layers suitable for Tier 5 Ironvein ambient temperatures.
